<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api-keys"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a paginated list of API keys, newest first. Administrators (`manage_options`)
see the keys of every user (with `user_id`); other users see only their own keys.

The full key value is never returned; only the first 8 characters are shown
(followed by `****`).

**Authentication**
The WordPress user must be authenticated: a logged-in session (cookie plus the
`X-WP-Nonce` header for REST calls), or a JWT in the header or cookie. Without it
WordPress answers `401` `rest_forbidden` before the plugin runs.

**Error format**
API key errors are `WP_Error` responses (`code: simple_jwt_login_api_key_error`).
When the API middleware or API keys are enabled they are rewritten into the plugin
envelope (`{"success": false, "data": {"message", "error_code"}}`); see `ApiKeyError`.
